Reason: retired as redundant/classical supporting work, limited to the named routes below. The useful structural results remain retained.

19 October 2026 UTC. Independent scope and comparator review; no accepted proof was rerun.

## Disposition

Approve retirement of the named ordinary block route and explicit interleaved materialized-frontier fast-transform activity. The original block route is ordinary Cooley–Tukey with Theta(N log N) work. The accepted later literal executor uses Theta(N^(5/3)) field/address work and Theta(N^(4/3)) live storage. Its selected positive-density materialized frontier itself requires Omega(N^(4/3)) writes. These routes cannot supply the sought sub-N-log-N improvement in their stated forms.

Preserve the accepted chirp/operator unfolding ranks, sparse core construction, exact paid executor, small-size exceptions and representation-specific lower bound as completed results. A different unselected contraction or compressed frontier is not an active task merely because it remains imaginable. The unrestricted selected-transform question remains mathematically unproved; this disposition makes no general lower-bound, worldwide-priority, bit-complexity or hardware-performance claim.

## Same-output classical comparison

The accepted model has N=2^n, a field with a supplied primitive Nth root omega, arbitrary ordinary-order dense input, charged scalar reads/writes and field operations, and O(log N)-bit addresses. Root existence excludes characteristic two for n>=1. The separately normalized interface supplies 1/sqrt(2).

For the signed-integer triangular chirp g(t)=omega^(-t(t+1)/2), the accepted identity is

C[ell,s]=g(ell-s)=g(ell) g(-s) omega^(ell s).

Thus Cx on every requested index is obtained by scaling input s by g(-s), applying one positive-sign length-N radix-two Fourier transform, and scaling output ell by g(ell). Conversely the accepted inverse diagonals convert convolution to the same positive-sign DFT. Every exponent is an integer triangular number. No division by two in the field, 2Nth root or field extension is required.

Generate root powers and both chirp diagonals by geometric-ratio recurrences with O(N) paid setup and storage. The dyadic radix-two transform costs O(N log N) exact field/address operations with O(N) working storage. Ordinary-order routing and output selection cost O(N+|E|), preserving requested ordering and multiplicities. If normalized output is requested, its already supplied normalization costs O(log N+|E|). Retain the source's O(QK^3) selected-header construction; it is N^o(1) in the accepted asymptotic regime. Total work is O(N log N+|E|+QK^3), and O(N+|E|+Q) storage suffices. For the original subset E, |E|<=N.

This directly dominates the named literal executor and the required materialized-frontier route. It does not reproduce their operator representation, and it need not: the comparison targets their arbitrary-input selected-output evaluation task, not the separately preserved representation theorem.

[2026-10-19; independently reviewed mixed completed-scope and named-route dispositions]
CLOSED: retired as redundant/classical supporting work. Prior activity status: TO RESEARCH.
Reason: retired as redundant/classical supporting work, limited to the named routes below. The useful structural results remain retained.

19 October 2026 UTC. Independent scope and comparator review; no accepted proof was rerun.

## Disposition

Approve retirement of the named ordinary block route and explicit interleaved materialized-frontier fast-transform activity. The original block route is ordinary Cooley–Tukey with Theta(N log N) work. The accepted later literal executor uses Theta(N^(5/3)) field/address work and Theta(N^(4/3)) live storage. Its selected positive-density materialized frontier itself requires Omega(N^(4/3)) writes. These routes cannot supply the sought sub-N-log-N improvement in their stated forms.

Preserve the accepted chirp/operator unfolding ranks, sparse core construction, exact paid executor, small-size exceptions and representation-specific lower bound as completed results. A different unselected contraction or compressed frontier is not an active task merely because it remains imaginable. The unrestricted selected-transform question remains mathematically unproved; this disposition makes no general lower-bound, worldwide-priority, bit-complexity or hardware-performance claim.

## Same-output classical comparison

The accepted model has N=2^n, a field with a supplied primitive Nth root omega, arbitrary ordinary-order dense input, charged scalar reads/writes and field operations, and O(log N)-bit addresses. Root existence excludes characteristic two for n>=1. The separately normalized interface supplies 1/sqrt(2).

For the signed-integer triangular chirp g(t)=omega^(-t(t+1)/2), the accepted identity is

C[ell,s]=g(ell-s)=g(ell) g(-s) omega^(ell s).

Thus Cx on every requested index is obtained by scaling input s by g(-s), applying one positive-sign length-N radix-two Fourier transform, and scaling output ell by g(ell). Conversely the accepted inverse diagonals convert convolution to the same positive-sign DFT. Every exponent is an integer triangular number. No division by two in the field, 2Nth root or field extension is required.

Generate root powers and both chirp diagonals by geometric-ratio recurrences with O(N) paid setup and storage. The dyadic radix-two transform costs O(N log N) exact field/address operations with O(N) working storage. Ordinary-order routing and output selection cost O(N+|E|), preserving requested ordering and multiplicities. If normalized output is requested, its already supplied normalization costs O(log N+|E|). Retain the source's O(QK^3) selected-header construction; it is N^o(1) in the accepted asymptotic regime. Total work is O(N log N+|E|+QK^3), and O(N+|E|+Q) storage suffices. For the original subset E, |E|<=N.

This directly dominates the named literal executor and the required materialized-frontier route. It does not reproduce their operator representation, and it need not: the comparison targets their arbitrary-input selected-output evaluation task, not the separately preserved representation theorem.
